```sh

git fetch origin d41ee399eae6b87de6b5ca6898f3556d7b04b40d && git checkout d41ee399eae6b87de6b5ca6898f3556d7b04b40d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c2b97c2a188d3a5798f5ee224a943ccb413c6396
```
